fact: ISO's member directory lists SENAPIQ STP (Service National de la Propriete Intellectuelle et de la Qualite) in Sao Tome and Principe as a correspondent member; the page names no law or decree and no standard, and carries no date, so its published year 2026 is used.

SENAPIQ-STP's own site describes it as a public institute with administrative, financial, technical and asset autonomy under the ministry responsible for industry (Ministry of Economy and Finance), whose functions include proposing policy on standardisation, certification, accreditation and metrology; it cites no law or decree and no standard, and carries no date, so its published year 2026 is used.
